footer.exportNote: Exports run locally. Nothing is uploaded.
footer.restoreNote: Your file is read and decrypted locally.
footer.importNote: Everything is always encrypted, on your device and when it syncs.

importPick.noMatch: No app matches. Most note apps can export Markdown files, and Markdown files import here.

folderImport.tagDesc: Your folders are rebuilt either way. This adds each folder name as a tag too, handy if you also like filtering by tag.

browserImport.tagDesc: Firefox saves tags and an address-bar keyword with a bookmark. Both become tags here.

contactImport.photosDesc_one: {{count}} photo, about {{size}} once the app sizes it down. That is {{pct}}% of the {{free}} you have free.
contactImport.photosDesc_other: {{count}} photos, about {{size}} once the app sizes them down. That is {{pct}}% of the {{free}} you have free.
contactImport.photosDescNoQuota_one: {{count}} photo, about {{size}} once the app sizes it down.
contactImport.photosDescNoQuota_other: {{count}} photos, about {{size}} once the app sizes them down.
contactImport.photosTooBig_one: Not enough space for the photo ({{size}}), so it is left out. Everything else comes across. Free up {{shortfall}}, or add storage, and import again to bring it in.
contactImport.photosTooBig_other: Not enough space for the {{count}} photos ({{size}}), so they are left out. Everything else comes across. Free up {{shortfall}}, or add storage, and import again to bring them in.

webcal.title: Webcal
webcal.desc: A calendar address, such as a webcal:// link from Google, iCloud, Proton, Outlook or Nextcloud. Import copies the events one time. Subscribe shows them in your calendar, read-only, and keeps them up to date while the app is open.
webcal.subscribeDesc: Paste a calendar address, such as a webcal:// link from Google, iCloud, Proton, Outlook or Nextcloud. Its events show in your calendar, read-only, and update while the app is open.

errors.invalid: Paste an address that starts with webcal://, webcals:// or https://.
errors.wrongType: This address does not lead to a calendar file.
errors.tooLarge: This calendar is larger than 10 MB.
errors.timeout: The calendar server did not answer in time. Try again later.
errors.blocked: The calendar server refused the download. Check that the calendar is shared or public.
errors.offline: You are offline. Connect and try again.
errors.limit: Too many downloads in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.failed: The calendar could not be downloaded. Check the address and try again.
errors.full: You can subscribe to {{max}} calendars at most. Remove one first.

sourceDesc.googleKeep: Google Takeout .zip (Keep folder) or a single .json note. Checklists import as native task lists.
sourceDesc.appleCalendar: In Calendar on a Mac, select one calendar, then File > Export > Export. Import that .ics file here. The calendar becomes a folder, and events keep their times, repeats and reminders.
sourceDesc.keepass: In KeePass, choose File > Export > KeePass XML (2.x). Each entry becomes a login with its 2FA key, extra websites, custom fields and dates, and its groups and tags become tags. Items in the Recycle Bin stay behind.
sourceDesc.lastpass: In LastPass, choose Advanced options > Export > Export data for use anywhere. Logins keep their 2FA key, secure notes and cards come along, and folders become tags.
sourceDesc.onePassword: In the 1Password app, choose File > Export, pick your account and the 1PUX format. Logins keep their 2FA key, extra websites and custom fields, cards, notes and identities come along, tags stay tags, and favorites and archived items keep their place. A CSV export works too, with logins only.
sourceDesc.dashlane: In Dashlane, choose Settings > Export data and the CSV format. Logins keep their 2FA key, secure notes and cards come along, and categories become tags. A .dash export is locked with a password and cannot be read.
sourceDesc.enpass: In Enpass, choose File > Export and the .json format. Logins keep their 2FA key, extra websites and custom fields, cards, notes and identities come along, folders become tags, and favorites and archived items keep their place. Items in the trash stay behind.
sourceDesc.nordpass: In NordPass, choose Settings > Export items. Logins keep their extra websites and custom fields, notes, cards and identities come along, and folders become tags.
sourceDesc.protonPass: In Proton Pass, choose Settings > Export and pick ZIP. Logins keep their 2FA key, extra websites, custom fields and dates, and notes, cards and identities come along. A CSV export works too, with less in it.
sourceDesc.keepassxc: In KeePassXC, choose Database > Export > XML File. Each entry becomes a login with its 2FA key, extra websites, custom fields and dates, and its groups and tags become tags. Items in the Recycle Bin stay behind. A CSV File export works too, with less in it.
sourceDesc.googleCalendar: The .zip from Google Calendar's Settings > Import & export, or one .ics file. Events keep their times, repeats and reminders.
sourceDesc.appleNotes: Export via the free Exporter app as Markdown, then drop the .zip here.
sourceDesc.appleJournal: Export from Journal on Mac or iPhone, compress the AppleJournalEntries folder, and drop the .zip. Entries import as journal entries with their photos, videos, voice memos, and locations.
sourceDesc.daylio: In Daylio choose More > Backup & Restore > Advanced Options > Export, close Daylio, and drop the .daylio file. Each entry becomes a journal entry with its mood, activities, scales, photos and voice memos. The CSV from More > Export Entries works too, without photos.
sourceDesc.diarium: In Diarium choose Export, pick JSON with Attachments on, and save to local storage. Drop the .zip, or a .json without attachments. Entries keep their rating as mood, tags, people, trackers, place and attachments.
sourceDesc.googleJournal: In Journal on your Pixel, turn on Settings > Back up your journal. Then choose Journal in Google Takeout and drop the .zip it sends. Entries keep their day, title, text, photos and videos.
sourceDesc.excalidraw: Drawings saved from excalidraw.com: one .excalidraw file, or several zipped together. Drawings from Obsidian's Excalidraw plugin work too, as .excalidraw.md files. Pictures inside a drawing come along.
sourceDesc.evernote: One .enex on its own, or several zipped together. Keeps formatting, tags, attachments, note links, and notebooks. Evernote leaves tasks out of .enex.
sourceDesc.samsungNotes: Export as Word (.docx) or Text (.txt). Zip multiple files for bulk import.
sourceDesc.simplenote: Export from Simplenote (Settings -> Tools -> Export Notes). Drop the .zip.
sourceDesc.standardNotes: Decrypted .zip or .txt backup from Standard Notes (Account settings > Backups > Data backups > Decrypted).
sourceDesc.obsidian: Obsidian vault as .zip. Preserves tags, note-links, folder structure, inline #tags, and embedded images and files. Canvases and Excalidraw drawings become drawings, and one .canvas file imports on its own too.
sourceDesc.obsidianCanvas: One .canvas file from your Obsidian vault, or the whole vault as a .zip to bring in every canvas. Each canvas becomes a drawing: cards, groups, arrows and colors come along, and pictures do too when they are in the .zip.
sourceDesc.notesnook: Notesnook export as .zip. Pick HTML when exporting to keep formatting, notebooks, tags, and attachments.
sourceDesc.bear: In Bear, choose File > Backup Notes... and drop the .bear2bk file here. Tags and nested tags, pins, the archive, the trash, highlights with their colors, note-links and attachments come along.
sourceDesc.joplin: The .jex file from File > Export all > "JEX - Joplin Export File". Notebooks become folders, and tags, to-dos, note links and attachments come along.
sourceDesc.anytype: The Any-Block v1 JSON .zip from space settings > Export, with files and archived objects included. Collections become folders, and tags, tasks, callouts, toggles, tables, note-links and files come along.
sourceDesc.siyuan: The Data.zip from the SiYuan menu > Data migration > Data.zip > Export, or a notebook exported as SiYuan .sy.zip. Notebooks and nested documents become folders, and tags, block references, callouts, math, tables and assets come along.
sourceDesc.upnote: In UpNote: Settings > Backup > Backup now, then zip everything in the backup folder. Keeps notebooks, tags, pins, note links, formatting, and attachments. Per-note exports from the phone apps work too - pick "Export to HTML".
sourceDesc.markdownFolder: .md or .txt files individually or as a .zip. A zipped folder keeps its subfolders and brings its images and attachments along.
sourceDesc.markdownApp: These notes are already Markdown files in a folder. Drop that folder in as a .zip and its subfolders, images, and #tags come with it.
sourceDesc.browserBookmarks: The bookmarks .html file from your browser’s "Export bookmarks", or the .zip Safari writes. Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, Opera, Brave, and Vivaldi all hold the same file. Folders and dates come along.
sourceDesc.vcard: The .vcf file your address book exports: iPhone and Mac through iCloud or Contacts, Android, Google Contacts. Every card comes across, photos included, and importing the same file twice skips the people you already have.
sourceDesc.bitwarden: Unencrypted .json vault export from Bitwarden (Tools > Export vault > .json). Logins, cards, SSH keys, secure notes, and TOTP codes all come along.
sourceDesc.browserPasswords: The passwords .csv from Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, Firefox, or Safari, or the .zip Safari writes. Each row becomes a login. Delete the file when you are done - it holds your passwords in plain text.

restorePick.intro: Restore a PrivacyNotes backup you exported earlier.
restorePick.fullBackupDesc: Restore notes, journals, vault items, tasks, images, audio, and files. A note you already have is kept, or updated if the backup holds a newer copy of it.
restorePick.encryptedBackupDesc: Restore an encrypted backup with your phrase key. A .pnbackupz brings everything back, files included; a .pnbackup carries text content and metadata only. You must be signed in with the same account that created it.

restoreGate.wait: Restore waits until this device is online and has completed a sync, so your backup is matched to the notes already in your account instead of adding them twice.
restoreGate.paused: Restore waits for sync, so your backup is matched to the notes already in your account, and sync is paused on this device: turn off Pause sync in Settings > ID & Sync.
restoreGate.belowFloor: Restore waits for sync, so your backup is matched to the notes already in your account, and this version of the app is too old to sync: update the app first.

status.writingNotes: Writing notes to your local library…

errors.decryptionFailed: Decryption failed. Wrong phrase or corrupted file.
errors.unreadable: This file could not be read. Check that it is the file {{importer}} exported, then try again.
errors.outOfMemory: This file ({{size}}) is too large to open on this device.
errors.importNothingChanged: Nothing was imported, and your notes, folders and files are as they were. {{detail}}
errors.blobImportFailed: Your notes imported, but their images and files did not: {{detail}} Nothing in the file you picked was changed, so you can delete the imported notes and run the import again.
errors.blobsNotInBackup_one: Your notes were restored, but {{items}} listed in the backup is missing from it.
errors.blobsNotInBackup_other: Your notes were restored, but {{items}} listed in the backup are missing from it.

preview.oversize_one: {{count}} note is over 1 MB. It stays on this device and does not sync.
preview.oversize_other: {{count}} notes are over 1 MB. They stay on this device and do not sync.
preview.splitOversize_one: Split this note into smaller notes at its headings, so it syncs
preview.splitOversize_other: Split these {{count}} notes into smaller notes at their headings, so they sync
preview.duplicateWarning: importing adds these as new notes. If you run this twice, you’ll get duplicates. There’s no automatic dedupe yet.
preview.duplicateSkipNote: bookmarks you have already saved are skipped, so running this twice will not duplicate anything.
preview.contactSkipNote: people you have already saved are skipped and left as they are, so running this twice will not duplicate anyone.
preview.eventSkipNote: events you have already imported are skipped and left as they are, so running this twice will not duplicate them.
preview.restoreMergeNote: notes from your own backup are matched by id. A note you already have is updated only when the backup's copy is newer, a note in your trash comes back out of it.
preview.quotaExceeded: Storage too low to import. Estimated {{needed}} needed, {{available}} available. Free up space or upgrade before importing.
preview.oversizeAttachments_one: 1 file is larger than the {{limit}} per-file limit on your plan. It imports to this device, but it will not sync to your other devices until you upgrade.
preview.oversizeAttachments_other: {{count}} files are larger than the {{limit}} per-file limit on your plan. They import to this device, but they will not sync to your other devices until you upgrade.
preview.title: Check before importing
preview.sourceTagDesc: Off: no tag for the source. Tags already in the notes come along either way.
preview.storageLine: This import needs about {{needed}}. You have {{available}} free.
preview.nothingWritten: Nothing is written until you press Import.

export.intro: Your data is yours. Export any time, for free.
export.manualIntro: A copy of everything, made now. Keep it somewhere safe.
export.zipBackupDesc: Your notes, journals, vault items, tasks, images, audio and files, with your medications and trackers. Opens on any computer with no phrase, so store it somewhere safe. Note History and your app lock PIN are not included.
export.encryptedZipBackupDesc: The same as the zip, sealed with your phrase key. Restores with your phrase on any device. Safe to store anywhere.
export.encryptedBackupDesc: All text content and metadata, with no images or files. A small file, sealed with your phrase key. Safe to store anywhere.
export.notesMarkdownDesc: Only your notes, one Markdown file each, in the same folders as in the app, with their pictures and files. No tasks, journal entries, events or vault items, and nothing from the trash. Not encrypted, so store it somewhere safe.
export.htmlArchiveDesc: One printable HTML page per note, logins, cards and keys included in plain text. Good for reading offline or archiving, not for restoring. Store it somewhere safe.
export.textBackupDesc: All text content and metadata as plain JSON. No images or files. Store somewhere you trust - this is not encrypted.
export.vaultExportDesc: Logins, cards, and SSH keys in Bitwarden-compatible format. Importable by most password managers. Plaintext - handle with care.
export.bookmarksExportDesc: The standard bookmarks file every browser reads. Import it into Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge with your folders intact.
export.contactsExportDesc: The vCard file every phone and address book reads. Import it into iPhone, Android, Google Contacts, or Contacts on the Mac, labels and groups intact.
export.calendarExportDesc: Events and dated notes and task lists, for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook.
export.drawingsExportDesc: Every drawing as its own .excalidraw file, pictures inside, for excalidraw.com and Obsidian.

exportProgress.missingFailed_one: This device could not download {{items}}, so your export leaves it out. Check your connection and export again.
exportProgress.missingFailed_other: This device could not download {{items}}, so your export leaves them out. Check your connection and export again.
exportProgress.missingNotFound_one: {{items}} is not on this device or on the server, so your export leaves it out.
exportProgress.missingNotFound_other: {{items}} are not on this device or on the server, so your export leaves them out.

upload.errorStorageFull: Storage full - free up space or add storage to upload this file.
upload.errorStorageFullKept: Doesn't fit in your storage - kept on this device. It will sync once space frees.
upload.errorTooLarge: File is too large ({{size}}). Maximum is {{limit}} MB.
upload.errorTooLargeFree: File is too large ({{size}}). Maximum is {{limit}} MB on the free plan.
upload.typesHint: Images, docs, audio, video, zip. Max {{limit}} MB / file.
upload.proPitch: Pro raises the limit to 50 MB per file.
upload.storagePitch: A storage plan raises it to 100 MB per file.

decryptErrors.tooSmall: This file is empty or incomplete ({{size}} bytes), so there is nothing to restore. Export the backup again and check that the saved file has a real size before importing it.
decryptErrors.notThisAccount: This backup could not be unlocked. A .pnbackup only opens in the account that created it, so this is usually a backup from a different account - to move notes between accounts, export a full backup (.zip) instead. If it is the right account, the file was damaged or saved incompletely.

exportErrors.generic: The export could not be saved. Please try again, or pick a different folder.

saveErrors.shortWrite: Only {{written}} of {{expected}} bytes were saved, so the file is incomplete. Try again and save to your device's own storage rather than a cloud folder.
saveErrors.protectedFolder: PrivacyNotes does not save into {{folder}}, because that folder holds keys, settings or programs. Save the file somewhere else and move it there yourself.

shareSheet.line: Nothing is saved until you choose.

destination.help: Folders from the source go inside the folder you pick, and items without a folder go into it.

auto.title: Automatic backups
auto.intro: A fresh copy of everything in a folder you pick. This device only.
auto.introDownload: This browser cannot write to a folder alone. PrivacyNotes tells you when a backup is due, and one click downloads it.
auto.calloutOffBody: A fresh encrypted copy, on a rhythm you pick.
auto.calloutOn: Automatic backups are on. Last backup: {{when}}.
auto.stepFolderHint: A folder that your cloud drive or NAS syncs puts a copy off this device.
auto.stepFolderHintAndroid: On this phone, or in an app that offers folders, such as Nextcloud.
auto.stepFolderHintIos: On this iPhone, or in iCloud Drive.
auto.stepFirstHint: You can change the type later.
auto.turnOn: Turn on and back up now
auto.typeFullHint: Notes, vault, pictures, audio and files, sealed with your phrase key. Safe to store anywhere.
auto.runsHintDesktop: Runs while PrivacyNotes is open or in the tray. A backup that came due while the app was closed runs a minute after it opens.
auto.runsHintWeb: Runs while PrivacyNotes is open in this browser. A backup that came due while it was closed runs a minute after it opens.
auto.runsHintDownload: PrivacyNotes can say that a backup is due only while it is open in this browser. One that came due while it was closed is offered a minute after it opens.
auto.runsHintPhone: A phone cannot make a backup while PrivacyNotes is closed. It runs when you open the app and one is due.
auto.pruneHint: When there are more, the oldest backup this device made goes. Other files in the folder are never touched.
auto.folderChanged: Earlier backups stay in the folder you used before.
auto.statusUnchanged: Checked {{when}}: no changes since the last backup
auto.wifiOnlyHint: A full backup can fetch pictures this phone does not hold.
auto.notify: Notify me when one is overdue
auto.notifyHint: A phone notification after two missed backups.
auto.logMissing_one: {{count}} picture or file was not included
auto.logMissing_other: {{count}} pictures or files were not included
auto.checkedHint: Checked: the app opened the sealed file again, and the copy in the folder matches it byte for byte.

cause.gone: The backup folder is not there.
cause.denied: PrivacyNotes may not write to the backup folder.
cause.full: There is no space left for the backup.
cause.mismatch: The saved file did not match its check, so it was removed.
cause.tooLarge: Your vault is too large to back up in one file on this device.
cause.seal: The backup did not pass its own check, so nothing was saved.
cause.permission: Your browser took back the permission to write to the folder.
cause.offline: There is no connection, and some pictures are not on this device.
cause.unknown: The backup could not be saved.

auto.shrunkTitle: This backup holds far fewer items
auto.shrunkBody: It holds {{items}} items. The one before held {{previous}}. Older backups stay in the folder until you confirm.
auto.permissionHint: Your browser can ask again after a restart. Choose "Allow on every visit" there and it stops asking.
auto.toastOverdue_one: Your last backup is {{count}} day old
auto.toastOverdue_other: Your last backup is {{count}} days old
auto.afterExport: Want this without thinking about it?
